title: Good, Functional Toaster for the Money
text:
Good, Functional Toaster for the Money. Toasters are a kitchen essential. I find we don’t use our toaster as much as we once did and since my previous toaster was well- worn and had room for 4 slices, I decided it was time for something new, and smaller. My choice was the MADETEC 2 Slice Wide Slot Toaster.

With this toaster, you get the basic needs for nicely toasted slices of bread, a heated bagel, a pastry, etc. The openings are wide so most anything you need to toast will fit. The toaster has buttons for defrost, bagel, or cancel, plus a knob with seven settings to control the darkness/duration of the heating cycle.

I have had good success with this toaster when I use it for bread and other foods. The toasting seems best when set on the four or five position, but things like toaster pastries are better if you dial it back a bit. The heating elements disperse the heat just enough so that a piece of bread comes out evenly toasted, for the most part. I have found the defrost setting to be a little less reliable and I often have to run it twice it get the job done. But this is better than having things burn, so it’s not really that bad. And the springs and cancel buttons work well, almost too well, in fact. Slices of bread often pop up too high and have come very close to landing on the counter.

The red colors on the sides of this toaster would have been enough to convince me not to get it in the not- too- distant past. But I just recently obtained a set of knives with a similar shade of red, so this toaster now has something in the kitchen to match. I might very well continue this trend with my other small appliances. I have always gone with black and stainless steel, but a change of colors is probably a good idea.

It’s always a good idea to replace worn- out kitchen appliances and the MADATEC 2 Slice Wide Slot Toaster has turned out to be a change for the better. We don’t use our toaster enough anymore to warrant a 4- slice model, so 2 slices suits us well and the red color is a trend I plan to continue. The functionality is good, too, even if the springs tend to release too suddenly. Overall, this is a good toaster for the price and it should suit most household needs.
